title: Close-out CI verdict names its commit only on green, and a cancelled ancestor run parks it
body: closeout.go:213/343 name ciSHA only on green; red/pending branches say 'the head that includes the close-out's own commits' even when the verdict was borrowed (:352/356). closeout_ci.go:108-122 stops at the first ancestor with any state and forge.go:323-331 maps cancelled to pending, which ci.yml's cancel-in-progress produces. No test moves the PR head during a close-out.
